title: The default pricing matrix sorts by its name and is not pinned first
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • The pricing matrix that shows the Default badge, {Default-matrix-A} (for example Default matrix), exists. Its name comes after AAA and before ZZ.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-A} (for example AAA-ZZAUTOTEST-PC40 first) exists. Its name comes before {Default-matrix-A}'s name.
  • Pricing matrix {Matrix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC40 last) exists. Its name comes after {Default-matrix-A}'s name.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  4. Read the first row and find {Default-matrix-A} and {Matrix-A}.
  5. Click the Matrix Category column header.
  6. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  7. Read the first row and find {Default-matrix-A} and {Matrix-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the first row is not {Default-matrix-A}. {Matrix-A} is above {Default-matrix-A}, which sits where its name puts it in A to Z order and shows its Default badge.
  • Step 7: the first row is not {Default-matrix-A}. {Matrix-B} is above it, and {Default-matrix-A} again sits where its name puts it, now in Z to A order, with its Default badge.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10135 (Story 2, Pricing Matrices, sortable column; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S2-R13, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Pricing matrices), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Canvas note 'Default rows do not move'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R13: “The default pricing matrix is not pinned. It sorts in the position its name gives it, in both directions, and keeps its Default badge there. This is the behavior the Pricing Matrices tab has in production today and it does not change. It is deliberately different from the Categories list, where the Default row is pinned first per S1-R19.”
  • SV-10135 acceptance criteria: “Given the default matrix, then it appears in the position its name gives it, carrying its Default badge, and is not pinned to the top.”
